# Nullary nested pair factory with a recursive Comparable slot

One Object-bounded method formal and one independent Comparable<? super V>
formal remain in a complete invariant Comparator<Map.Entry<K,V>> result.
The fixture covers an opaque owned factory and the actual SDK comparingByValue
entry. Four frozen routes compare 96 cases twice with source and SDK providers,
compiling every output and auditing all original entries and metadata. Factory
callbacks, returned identity, value getter order, raw/null values, recursive
comparison dispatch and exact unchecked/hidden checked failures remain visible.
Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving shared-Signature controls guard the
proof. Only authored fixtures and the trusted Java SDK execute.
